jobs.title: Human Capital - Product Operations Associate
jobs.location: New York, NY; office-based (hybrid arrangement not specified)
jobs.salary: $110,000–$130,000 base plus year-end bonus (first-year bonus guaranteed); fully above $100K
jobs.why: Strong early-career product/business operations bridge supporting recruiting and employee-support systems. The JD emphasizes user issue troubleshooting, coordinating system changes, scoping requirements, testing and rollout support, stakeholder feedback, configuration and data quality audits. Audrey has Salesforce requirements/UAT/workflow automation, 10+ years of Salesforce data audit experience, documentation and stakeholder training at Orion, plus recruiting/onboarding system automation and 450+ staffing-record consolidation at Horizon Blue ABA. The role explicitly offers guidance on small product projects and a path toward product management.
jobs.gap: No verified administration of user access/permissions across multiple HR systems, independent product feature rollout ownership, or direct experience with the firm's proprietary human capital technology. NYC office attendance details not specified.
